title: FlashVLA: Streaming Action Decoding for Fast and Asynchronous VLA Inference
authors: Zekai Li, Jiaming Tang, Zhijian Liu

tldr.en: Use staggered-noise action buffers and chunk-causal attention so a warmed stream emits an executable chunk per forward pass.
tldr.zh: 用错开噪声等级的动作缓冲与块级因果注意力，使预热后的流每次前向输出一个可执行动作块。

evaluation_scope.en: π0.5, SmolVLA, LingBot-VLA; LIBERO/RoboTwin 2.0 and Franka. Each chunk still traverses multiple denoising stages; fine-tuning and cold start matter.
evaluation_scope.zh: π0.5、SmolVLA、LingBot-VLA；LIBERO/RoboTwin 2.0 与 Franka。每个块仍经历多级去噪，需要微调并考虑冷启动。
